---
title: "Annotated location means"
description: "Mean position per location, labelled with Matplotlib."
date: 2026-01-12
categories: [customisation]
tags: [Visualizations]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-annotated-location-means
#| fig-alt: "Mean ISO coordinates labelled by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

means = data.groupby("LocationID")[["ISOPleasant", "ISOEventful"]].mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))
sspy.scatter(
    means.reset_index(),
    x="ISOPleasant",
    y="ISOEventful",
    title="Mean ISO coordinates by location",
    diagonal_lines=True,
    ax=ax,
)

for name, row in means.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(
        str(name),
        (row["ISOPleasant"], row["ISOEventful"]),
        xytext=(10, 5),
        textcoords="offset points",
        fontsize=10,
        fontweight="bold",
    )
plt.show()
```
